value.rationale: The result isolates a canonical perturbation effect that scalar invariants miss: \(\operatorname{Cr}_n\) and \(K_{n,n}\) have the same lower and upper irredundance numbers, while the matching deletion creates exactly the new cubic and quartic mixed layers and changes which mixed two-sets are maximal. This is a complete structural classification for a standard graph family rather than a routine recomputation of a known scalar value.
